items.title: Joel Dorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007
items.q: I depend on Gene a lot. ... he gets the sound that I would ask for if I knew what to ask for.

ctx.x: Are you one of those people who say that there’s something missing from the analog?

There is something missing from a certain part of the analog recordings but at that little studio that you were in we have our own way of making digital sound like analog. You saw what we did. You know, so we have all that cutting edge equipment on the right and all the shit we stole from Atlantic on the left when the studio closed. We got all those limiters and compressors and out of print pieces of equipment. And Gene really knows what he’s doing. He’s Les Paul’s kid. He grew up in the house where most of this…
Yeah. And you’ve got these two things here.
